clips.label: Rainbow Mane · transformation and pullback
clips.note: A white cartoon face becomes a rainbow-maned horse. This is an opening feasibility test; the separate head turn remains unresolved.
clips.details:
Original character developed from Olof's round white face and rainbow mohawk idea, using the supplied comic-print visual references. Krea generates the opening and repaints its own previous image after spatial warping. The first quiet turn attempt did not achieve a side profile; stronger repainting altered the face more than the pose. This cut keeps an early portrait, changes to a horse, then tests the widening view. The transformation is abrupt and passes through two different horse designs. A stronger final repaint reveals the full body but also changes the composition quickly around 5.4 seconds.

1280×720, 24 fps; 66 selected paintings from four preserved passages, source cadence 12, delivery 4.5× source speed. RIFE fills the two- and three-frame painting intervals outside recurrence. Human playback and style judgment pending. No final story ending has been selected.

clips.note: Same prompts, seeds and movement after the shared opening. Stronger repainting changes the drawing more than its orientation.
